title: 27.5KB language-agnostic WebGPU syntax highlighter
summary: A lightweight 27.5KB syntax highlighter that leverages WebGPU for GPU-accelerated text highlighting, offering language-agnostic support with exceptional performance.
problem_solved: Provides high-performance syntax highlighting by offloading computation to GPU, addressing the performance limitations of traditional CPU-based highlighters.
why_valuable: Combines tiny bundle size (27.5KB) with GPU acceleration for near-instant syntax highlighting across multiple programming languages.
